source_note: Initial editorial selection verified 10 November 2026. Automatically refreshed after GitHub Actions is enabled.

news.title: Final major vacuum-vessel sector reaches ITER site
news.summary: All the major components for the machine's core are on site, shifting attention to complex assembly, weld quality and integration.
news.why: Follow tolerances, joining, inspection and large-component logistics.

news.title: Thea Energy and MIT plan stellarator magnet validation
news.summary: A partnership will test an encircling coil concept intended for a stellarator design.
news.why: Pay attention to magnetic-field accuracy, coil manufacturing and test validation.

news.title: Europe starts new buildings for ITER heating systems
news.summary: New construction work supports additional heating facilities and bridges at the international fusion site.
news.why: Heating is a systems-integration problem involving high-power electronics, cooling and mechanical services.

news.title: South Korea announces major new fusion R&D push
news.summary: The country's new programme signals continued investment in domestic research and fusion capability.
news.why: Watch how national strategies influence science priorities and industrial supply chains.

news.title: Additively manufactured tungsten tiles tested at DIII-D
news.summary: Printed tungsten components survived plasma exposure in a materials experiment.
news.why: A direct link between materials processing, quality and plasma-facing component performance.

news.title: U.S. announces 28 fusion public–private research awards
news.summary: An $8.5 million round of INFUSE awards connects companies with national laboratories and universities.
news.why: See how engineering capability moves between research institutions and commercial developers.

news.title: ITER toroidal-field coil reaches half nominal operating current in cold test
news.summary: A large toroidal-field magnet was energized to 34 kA during testing, with further higher-current testing planned.
news.why: Consider cold acceptance testing, electrical insulation, structural forces and test sequencing.

news.title: India-based startup advances compact tokamak roadmap
news.summary: A private fusion developer describes its plans for a larger research tokamak after earlier experimental work.
news.why: Follow the growing variety of approaches beyond national laboratories.

news.title: Europe signs first procurement arrangements for fusion materials test facility
news.summary: Supply arrangements for IFMIF-DONES move the international neutron-materials research facility forward.
news.why: Understand how structural materials are qualified for future neutron exposure.

news.title: Germany and U.S. launch joint centre for fusion research
news.summary: Max Planck researchers and Columbia University formed a joint research centre spanning advanced fusion physics.
news.why: Follow cross-border work in stellarators, plasma transport and shared modelling.

news.title: New Wendelstein 7-X campaign examines long-pulse operation
news.summary: International collaborators are exploring hotter, better-confined plasmas, turbulence and sustained discharges.
news.why: Observe how diagnostics, control and wall loading intersect.

news.title: China begins constructing hydrogen–boron fusion research platform
news.summary: ENN has begun building the Helong-2 platform for exploration of hydrogen–boron plasma research.
news.why: Compare alternative fuels with the more mature deuterium–tritium approach and their distinct challenges.

papers.title: Towards reactor-relevant electromagnetic turbulence in a spherical tokamak
papers.summary: A route into understanding turbulence in a device geometry that could matter for reactor operation.
papers.question: How does turbulence alter confinement and predicted performance?

papers.title: Implicit–Explicit Methods for the GX Gyrokinetics Code
papers.summary: Numerical techniques for making gyrokinetic simulations more efficient.
papers.question: Which time scales make plasma simulations costly?

papers.title: Quantum computing for plasma physics in magnetic-confinement fusion
papers.summary: A review of where quantum methods may help fusion simulation—and where they are not yet practical.
papers.question: What exactly limits computational models today?

papers.title: A programmable stellarator–tokamak hybrid for magnetic-configuration discovery
papers.summary: A research proposal for a flexible field-configuration platform using many controllable coils.
papers.question: Could programmable coils reduce design iteration time?

papers.title: A new class of optimized stellarators with zero bootstrap current
papers.summary: Theory concerning magnetic-field optimization and intrinsic current control in stellarators.
papers.question: Why does magnetic topology matter for steady-state operation?
